data.reviewed_base: FD revision 8; implementation diff previously reviewed against AIW HEAD 2e9d0c1; this follow-up reviewed the README and stable-spec documentation changes

findings.finding: The stable spec still says shutdown MUST reuse existing process-tree cleanup. FD-112 removed App Server process launch/pool and the Linux/Windows process-tree management files. Current shutdown performs HTTP graceful shutdown, closes proxy connections, and waits for content cleanup; no App Server process tree remains to clean.
findings.impact: The stable spec retains a lifecycle guarantee for a removed execution path and overstates current shutdown behavior.
findings.minimal_action: Remove the obsolete process-tree cleanup phrase while preserving global cancellation, active HTTP/proxy connection shutdown, content cleanup completion, and state-lock release requirements.

resolved_prior_findings: README now scopes state_dir/requests persistence and local usage statistics to openai_codex, and explicitly says openai_proxy does not persist request metadata or provide local usage statistics.

Stable spec now has a separate development/shared deployment listener and peer requirement: development uses loopback listener/peer; shared requires explicit listen. The added requirement does not restore App Server lifecycle rules.
